text:
ryan: Hey folks — trying to add my spouse during open enroll. Partner is on a dependent visa and doesn't have an SSN yet. I uploaded passport + marriage cert but the benefits portal rejects the upload (error 415). Payroll says cutoff this Friday. What do I do? @Aisha

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks Ryan — quick steps: 1) Prefer single PDF with all docs (passport, marriage certificate, visa page). 2) If the portal errors, email benefits@redwood.com with subject 'OpenEnroll - Ryan - Spouse docs' and attach PDFs (max 5MB each). 3) Include a short cover note with spouse DOB, address, and statement that SSN is pending. We'll intake manually and confirm.

ryan: Do I need to wait for the SSN before coverage can start? I need coverage as soon as possible.

Aisha (People Ops): You don't need an SSN to provision coverage. We can approve conditional coverage effective the first of the month after we verify documents. If docs (or the manual email) arrive by payroll cutoff we'll make it effective the same month and prorate. If after cutoff, starts next month.

ryan: Payroll cutoff time — is that midnight PT Friday?

Leah (Payroll): Hey — cutoff for benefits election changes is 11:59pm PT on Friday for that payroll cycle. If documents are uploaded or emailed before that time we'll queue for the same-month effective date. After that, it's next month. Note: retroactive changes are limited to newborns/adoptions and require exception approval.

ryan: Portal rejection seems to happen when I combine scanned photos from my phone into one PDF. Can I just send photos?

Aisha (People Ops): Please combine into a single PDF (flattened), that usually resolves image encoding issues. If the portal still rejects it, send the PDF to benefits@redwood.com. Do NOT send sensitive docs over Slack. If you prefer, reply here and I'll generate a secure upload link.

ryan: One more Q — do translations need to be notarized? My marriage cert is in English but issued by a foreign registrar.

Aisha (People Ops): If the doc is already in English and issued by an official authority, notarization is not required. If the document is not in English, send a certified translation plus the original; the translator attestation is needed.

Maria (Benefits Ops): For our intake team, please name files like: ryan_spouse_passport.pdf, ryan_spouse_marriage.pdf, ryan_spouse_visa.pdf and include spouse full name + DOB in the email body. That speeds manual processing.

ryan: Anything I should know about tax withholding while spouse has no SSN/ITIN yet?

Leah (Payroll): Tax advice is best from your tax advisor. Operationally: we can't set an ITIN in payroll until issued. You can update withholding once ITIN arrives. This doesn't block benefits eligibility. If you need a temporary change to W-4 withholding, open a ticket with payroll and reference the intake ID once processed.

ryan: Sending PDFs to benefits@redwood.com now. Appreciate the quick help.

benefits-bot: Automated: Received manual intake for Ryan. Intake ID: INT-20261112-4521. Expect confirmation email within 1 business day.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll follow up once intake is processed. @Leah please flag if INT-20261112-4521 arrives before cutoff for same-month effect.

Leah (Payroll): Got it — I'll watch for INT-20261112-4521. If it lands before 11:59pm PT Friday we'll queue it for this month's effective date.

ryan: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
